overview.oneLineTake: Tech led a broad sell-off with a volatility spike, so expect choppy, defensive trade until Nvidia and rate headlines settle.
themes: Broad risk off: SPY closed at 715.87 (-1.96%) and QQQ at 645.04 (-2.19%) on Thursday, with the S&P 500 heading for a sixth straight decline after an intraday reversal to new lows.
Anthropic's Nasdaq debut rose on its own but could not stop the sell-off, while tech sentiment stays fragile and CoreWeave saw profit taking.
Nvidia keeps sliding on CEO transition fallout despite strong Q3 results, down about $669 billion in six sessions, and a California subpoena over China chip diversion adds pressure.
AMD dropped on a short-seller report alleging China exposure, and Intuit's downbeat outlook deepened software worries.
UnitedHealth fell on a government crackdown signal on Medicare Advantage fraud, leading a sector sell-off.
risks: Rates: the 10-year Treasury yield was 5.07% on Nov 18, and hawkish Fed commentary keeps inflation fears in play.
Concentration: AI and mega cap tech weakness is dragging the indexes, with Nvidia headlines still unresolved.
Weak macro signals: pending home sales hit a three decade low.

nq.summary: NDX cash fell 2.21% to 26,517 Thursday after reversing from a 27,749 high, closing near the lows as the Anthropic debut failed to lift tech. NVDA lost another 3.3% on China chip probes and the CEO fight, and VIX jumped 15.8% to 28.44. NQ is holding a tight 26,416 to 26,604 range overnight with Asia weak. Thesis: bearish, 6/10, sell rips into resistance. Invalidation: NDX above 27,116. NDX levels: resistance 26,849 (Wed L), 27,116 (Wed close), 27,749 (Thu H); support 26,482 (Thu L), 26,250, 26,000 (round).
